content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on a blower setup with a slide gate. When the blower shuts off, the slide gate motor should operate for 2 minutes. My current configuration connects to the line for the blower, uses a NOT function block, followed by a relay with a 2-minute delay, and then the output. However, when wiring up the [product_name], the output is triggered immediately. What is the correct way to achieve the desired behavior?

Hello, If you require an off-delay timer, it may be better suited than using a wiping relay. You can find detailed information about each function block in the online help resources. Hope this is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing difficulty in setting up an off-delay function using a [product_name] for a motor that needs to operate after another device switches off. There is uncertainty about which logic or relay functions achieve the required delay, suggesting some confusion regarding available programming options and documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates the [product_name] will offer an intuitive method to set up an off-delay timer so the slide gate motor operates for a set duration following the shutdown of the blower.
